question: What is the measured extent from the fire of time to the staff-bearer and what bounds the egg above?
premises: From the fire of time up to the staff-bearer the distance is eighty-eight crores.
Above that, within the cosmic egg, there is a shell.
That shell is solid and one crore yojanas thick.
inference: The cosmic egg has a vast measured interior culminating below a dense outer shell of enormous thickness.
plain_english: From the fire of time up to the staff-bearer the distance is eighty-eight crores. Above that, within the cosmic egg, is a solid shell one crore yojanas thick.
